name: What are common hidden costs in garage conversions?

mainEntity.name: What are common hidden costs in garage conversions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Foundation retrofit ($5-15K), electrical panel upgrade ($3-8K), HVAC ($4-12K), egress windows ($2-5K each), and parking area improvements if required.
